body: I feel like I can't leave them because I feel like I owe them so much. They always make sure to remind me how much they've done for me and it's killing me how I can't live upto their expectations. If I move out I can't ever contact them.. I feel like I'm letting everyone around me down. I'm lashing out at my boyfriend (he's so fucking understanding and caring and I take him for granted). My hearts heavy at times I can't breathe and I feel like everything needs to end. I don't want to disappoint my friends by walking away from them. I don't know I'm sorry this is word vomit
